entities.name: Sundering of the Helvault
entities.description: The destruction of the Helvault on Innistrad, freeing Avacyn, Nahiri and others.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A blessed silver prison created by Sorin Markov to contain threats to humans.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the Helvault stood.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel who used the Helvault to seal away demons, was trapped inside, and returned when it broke.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who trapped himself and Avacyn in the Helvault and was obliterated by Liliana.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor lithomancer planeswalker imprisoned in the Helvault by Sorin and freed by its destruction.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who created the Helvault and imprisoned Nahiri.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon sealed within the Helvault by Avacyn.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who coerced Thalia into shattering the Helvault to kill Griselbrand.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Guardian of the Helvault who chose to let it be broken to save her people.

entities.name: Mikaeus Cecani
entities.description: A deceased Lunarch whose corpse Liliana raised to learn where Griselbrand was.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Geralf's sister, who laid siege to the High City.

entities.name: Cathedral of Avacyn
entities.description: Site of Liliana's confrontation with Thalia.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact Liliana used to obliterate Griselbrand.

entities.name: Voluptara Highwater
entities.description: A demon freed from the Helvault.

events.summary: Sorin creates the Helvault so Avacyn can seal away threats; she battles demons such as Ormendahl for about a thousand years.
events.quote: and sealing them within the Helvault

events.summary: Hundreds of years earlier, Nahiri seeks Sorin's aid; provoked, he has Avacyn imprison her in the Helvault.
events.quote: the resulting confrontation led to Nahiri’s imprisonment within the vault

events.summary: In 4557 AR Griselbrand tricks Avacyn into banishing him into the Helvault and pulls her in, sealing them both.
Liliana raises Mikaeus Cecani's corpse and learns Griselbrand is trapped in the Helvault.
events.quote: learning from him that Griselbrand was trapped in the Helvault

events.summary: Liliana coerces Thalia into letting her shatter the Helvault, and it bursts apart, freeing everything inside.
events.quote: Thalia chose to save her people and allow Liliana to break open the Helvault.

events.summary: Avacyn returns and leads a renewed crusade of angels; holy magic is restored.
events.quote: Avacyn returned to the world, leading a renewed crusade of angels to protect humanity.

events.summary: Liliana uses the Chain Veil to obliterate Griselbrand permanently.
events.quote: Liliana used the Chain Veil to obliterate him permanently
She planeswalked away to her home world of Zendikar

events.summary: Voluptara Highwater is freed from the Helvault.
events.quote: Voluptara Highwater was another demon who was freed from the Helvault upon its destruction.

relations.quote: by the vampire planeswalker Sorin Markov

relations.note: Obliterated him with the Chain Veil.
relations.quote: Liliana used the Chain Veil to obliterate him permanently

relations.note: Her former ally who imprisoned her.
relations.quote: Nahiri's imprisonment at the hands of her former ally Sorin
Although Thalia had sworn to protect the Helvault
killed by his cousin Geralf Cecani
